correctness.rationale: The 12 vertices are cube edges; face membership for dissociation Ind_2(L(Q3)) is equivalent to every selected graph vertex having at most one selected neighbor. Exhaustive 4095 nonempty masks yield face vector (12,66,164,177,36), 455 faces and 1512 Hasse covering relations. Deterministic vertex-toggle matching stages (0,126),(11,55),(5,15),(8,15) remove 211 pairs, leaving one critical 0-cell and 32 critical 3-cells. Reversing matched edges in the FULL face-poset Hasse graph gives an acyclic digraph with all 455 vertices topologically sorted; Forman yields an integral wedge of 32 S³, not merely mod-2 homology. Independently rebuilt masks, toggles and directed acyclicity. Signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz formula and full 48 cube symmetries give the stated 10-class rational H3 character, average 96/48=2 invariant dimension, antipodal trace 10 and 21/11 eigensplit. Package contains two distinct finite graph constructions with same character. This exactly finite census is exhaustive for this 12-vertex object, not a universal theorem for larger graph families.
